content.title: How to watch Valspar Championship 2026, tee times, TV schedule
content.text: Updated March 19, 2026, 12:37 p.m. ETThe PGA Tour's Florida swing winds down with this week's Valspar Championship at the unforgiving Innisbrook Resort's Copperhead Course.With The Players Championship last week and the Masters around the corner, the field on the Florida Gulf Coast isn't the strongest. It furthered weakened when Arnold Palmer Invitational champion Akshay Bhatia joined Robert MacIntyre, Sudarshan Yellamaraju, Keith Mitchell and Max Greyserman in withdrawing from the tournament.But there are still seven players in the World Golf Ranking's top 20 taking part, including Matt Fitzpatrick, Xander Schauffele and Jacob Bridgeman, who finished second, third and tied for fifth at The Players. Defending Valspar champ Viktor Hovland will defend his title, and 2025 U.S. Open winner J.J. Spaun will take part along with Justin Thomas and Brooks Koepka.Watch Valspar Championship live on SlingHere's everything you need to know about the Arnold Palmer Invitational, including TV schedule and streaming information:What channel is Valspar Championship on today? Time, TV scheduleAll times Eastern:Thursday, March 19: Golf Channel (2-6 p.m.)Friday, March 20: Golf Channel (2-6 p.m.)Saturday, March 21: Golf Channel (1-3 p.m.) | NBC (3-6 p.m.)Sunday, March 22: Golf Channel (1-3 p.m.) | NBC (3-6 p.m.)Rounds 1 and 2 of the 2026 Valspar Championship will broadcast nationally on Golf Channel starting at 2 p.m. March 19-20. Rounds 3 and 4 will start on Golf Channel at 1 p.m. before switching to NBC at 3 p.m. March 21-22. Streaming options include Peacock, NBCUniversal's subscription streaming service, and Sling, which carries Golf Channel and NBC.Where to watch Valspar Championship on streamingAll times Eastern:Thursday, March 19: ESPN app (7:30 a.m.-6 p.m.)Friday, March 20: ESPN app (7:30 a.m.-6 p.m.)Saturday, March 21: ESPN app (7:45 a.m.-6 p.m.)Sunday, March 22: ESPN app (7:45 a.m.-6 p.m.)Featured group and hole streaming is available on PGA Tour Live on ESPN+ (available on the ESPN app with a Select plan).
